The '''Retro TV''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased for {{Price|200|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s from [[George]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. It may be placed anywhere indoors.

Players can view [[television]] programs by {{key|right-clicking}} on the Retro TV.
